review_notes: I reviewed the whole target file. I also read the supporting definitions it uses: amnrCurveCompose, amnrCurveOperator and amnrCurveOperatorMap in CurveOperators.lean, and amnrRestrictState and amnrStateDerivative in StateDerivatives.lean. The only new definition in the target is amnrCurveJointCompose. It is a thin named wrapper that feeds the time-dependent field fun t x => f (η t, x) to amnrCurveCompose. It could be written with the Mathlib composition ContinuousMap.comp applied to the pairing η.prodMk u. That alone does not justify a finding, because the wrapper is a named specialisation that fixes the argument orientation and has a documented role as the integral-equation substitution. I found no duplicated API surface or repeated conversions that would make removing it worthwhile. The other declarations are theorems. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so they are out of scope. The helper definitions in other files might overlap Mathlib constructions, but they are outside the target file, and I did not establish a concrete cost. I abstain.
